Official Challenge Rules

✦
  1. 01.Team size is exactly 4 members. No exceptions.
  2. 02.All team members must be currently enrolled students.
  3. 03.Registration fee is 300 per participant.
  4. 04.Code must be written during the 24-hour window. Assets & libraries allowed.
  5. 05.Submissions must include a playable build.
  6. 06.Respect the arena. Zero tolerance for harassment or plagiarism.
  7. 07.Judges' decisions are final.
